proposal.scope: Planar terminal XY proposal for one visible green rigid proxy under the supplied orthographic calibration. This is spatial grounding only; it is not motor learning.
limitations: The color rule does not establish object identity; it detects a green candidate only.
The projection assumes the supplied fixed orthographic calibration and does not estimate depth.
position_bound_m is a caller-declared bound; this tool does not calibrate or independently validate it.
Approximate 5 Hz sampling can miss changes between frames or brief terminal states; the last selected frame may precede the actual clip end.
No contact, support, grasp, action, force, or causal information is inferred.
A stable terminal image window is not proof of physical rest or successful task completion.
No robot policy is learned or qualified by this proposal.
proposal.timing_scope: Local stat, probe, decode, observation and source hashing wall time; excludes acquisition, terminal dwell before upload, network and actuation.

limitations: All videos and trials are synthetic PiPER rigid-block simulations, not human footage or shoes.
A known green proxy and a trusted fixed orthographic camera supply XY only. No identity, depth, force or contact is inferred from pixels.
The policy, grasp phases, IK and recovery are authored. This experiment trains no motor model and has no action-label learning curve.
The controller still uses privileged live simulator joint/object/contact observations. Only its destination comes from the video.
A stationary visible centroid cannot certify correct completion or physical rest. A wrong calibration or same-color lookalike can produce a wrong proposal.
Compute latency excludes capture, the observation dwell, network, transport and physical actuation. These trials do not qualify a physical robot.
